notes: Original gravimetric H2 isotherms (Fig. 5a-d, 0-20 bar, -196 C) and 20 bar values (Table 2) for 12 KOH-activated ZIF-8/furfuryl-alcohol-derived templated carbons (as-prepared and compacted at 5 and 10 tonnes). N2 BET surface area (P/P0 0.06-0.22) and micropore area reported for every one of the 12 samples (Table 1), on the same samples as the H2 uptake. Fig. 5 caption calls the values 'Total hydrogen uptake'; basis not defined (matters for extraction, not eligibility). The paper gives no carbon mass fraction, but the sorbents are carbonised, KOH-activated, HCl-washed templated carbons (Section 2.1), so I2 is met under the section 3 definition. record.json is_retracted is false and the text has no retraction notice. Original research article, not a review. No statement that the H2 values were published before (the text says 'this is the first time that the hydrogen uptake of a high surface area carbon has been improved by compaction only'), so duplicate_data does not apply. Text layer drops minus signs and degree symbols and some ligatures; quotes were checked against the page images (main-3, main-5, main-6).
